items.title: Malaysian villages shaken as blasts rock southern Thailand
items.summary: Residents of Malaysian villages near the Thailand border were left shaken this weekend after hearing loud booms and seeing flashes of light across the frontier, as Thai authorities confirmed more than 50 coordinated attacks on Saturday night. The blasts, heard in Kampung Lubok Gong and Kampung Tersang in Malaysia’s Kelantan state, coincided with a wave of near-simultaneous attacks across 21 districts in Thailand’s Narathiwat, Pattani and Yala provinces beginning around 8pm local time on...

items.titleZh: 泰国南部发生爆炸，马来西亚边境村庄受惊
items.summaryZh: 泰国南部周六晚发生超过50起协同袭击，马来西亚吉兰丹州的边境村庄居民听到了爆炸声并看到了闪光。此次袭击波及泰国那拉提瓦、北大年和也拉三省的21个地区。
items.whyImportant: 跨境安全事件引发了对地区局势不稳定的担忧。

items.summary: Exclusive: New entrants the only cohort making more loan applications amid interest rate rises and tax changes, mortgage broker says Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast First home buyers are still taking out a large number of loans, with government backing, even as investors step back from Australia’s property market. New entrants are now the only cohort applying for more loans than they were in June, according to new data from the mortgage broker network Loan Market. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 数据显示：澳大利亚房产投资者退场，首套房买家贷款需求依然强劲
items.summaryZh: 尽管利率上升且税收政策调整，但在政府支持下，澳大利亚首套房买家仍是贷款申请的主力军。抵押贷款经纪公司Loan Market的数据显示，首套房买家是目前唯一贷款申请量高于6月份的群体。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了澳大利亚房地产市场在政策干预下的结构性变化。

items.title: UK PM Andy Burnham to visit Kyiv on Monday as Ukraine marks independence anniversary
items.summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham will visit Kyiv on Monday on his first international visit since taking office last month, his office said, as Ukraine marks its 35th independence anniversary. Burnham has vowed to give strong support to Ukraine as it battles Russia’s invasion. items.titleZh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆将于周一访问基辅，乌克兰纪念独立周年
items.summaryZh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆将在上任后首次出访基辅，以纪念乌克兰独立35周年。他宣布英国将允许国防公司MBDA分享SCALP远程导弹的分类组件信息，以支持乌克兰建立本地组装能力。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着英国对乌克兰军事支持的进一步深化。

More than 270 leading marine scientists from 84 research institutes have written to the environment minister, Murray Watt, urging stronger protections for marine ecosystems, as a once-in-a-decade review of marine parks gets under way. items.summaryZh: 超过270名海洋科学家致信环境部长，批评政府将大部分受保护的海洋公园设在偏远地区，而忽视了大陆附近脆弱的生态系统。他们呼吁在十年一度的海洋公园审查中加强对独特生态环境的保护。
items.whyImportant: 这引发了关于政府环保政策优先级的争议。

items.title: ‘Absurd’: children to see gambling logos on sports jerseys until 2032 in transition period condemned by Pocock

items.summaryZh: 尽管政府承诺切断体育与博彩业的联系，但立法规定了五年的过渡期，这意味着儿童在2032年前仍可能在球衣上看到赌博标志。此举遭到了波科克等人的强烈谴责。

items.title: US territories hit out at Trump plan to explore deep sea mining in the Pacific
items.summary: US agency releases plan to lease millions of hectares of seabed off the coast of the Northern Mariana Islands and Guam A US government plan to lease out millions of hectares of seabed near the Mariana Trench for deep sea exploration has drawn opposition from US territories in the Pacific, as the Trump administration remains locked in a race with China for control of critical ocean minerals. On Tuesday, the Marine Mineral Administration (MMA), an agency under the US department of the interior, released a proposal to auction deep sea mining leases for 28m hectares (69m acres) of seafloor off the coast of the Northern Mariana Islands and Guam. items.titleZh: 美国领地反对特朗普在太平洋进行深海采矿的计划
items.summaryZh: 美国内政部下属机构计划拍卖马里亚纳海沟附近2800万公顷的海底采矿权，引发了关岛和北马里亚纳群岛的反对。此举被视为特朗普政府在关键矿产资源上与中国竞争的举措。
items.whyImportant: 深海采矿计划引发了环境与地缘政治的双重争议。

items.title: Divorcing devices: how digital detox helps Hongkongers ‘carve out moments’
items.summary: In the second instalment of a five-part Health Matters wellness series on Hong Kong’s growing wellness trends, Fiona Sun looks into how residents are embracing digital detox, as experts warn that excessive screen use is linked to anxiety, depression and sleep disorders. For Robert Broad, stepping away from electronic devices has become part of a self-care routine he developed after the Covid-19 pandemic. The 56-year-old recalled how spending long hours in front of screens while working remotely...

items.summaryZh: 随着过度使用屏幕与焦虑、抑郁及睡眠障碍的关联日益凸显，香港居民正逐渐拥抱“数字排毒”。专家建议通过减少电子设备使用来改善心理健康。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了现代社会对数字生活方式的反思与健康意识的提升。

items.titleZh: 缅怀朱镕基及其历史遗产
items.summaryZh: 中国前总理朱镕基逝世，引发了公众对其执政遗产的深切缅怀与反思。文章回顾了其在任期间的贡献及其对当代中国的影响。
items.whyImportant: 朱镕基的逝世引发了对中国改革开放历史进程的广泛讨论。

items.title: Record non-DSE admissions to Hong Kong’s universities spark calls for quotas
items.summary: Hong Kong public universities have admitted a record number of students applying outside the local exam system, with the intake surging by 63 per cent over seven years to account for nearly 30 per cent of the 15,000 government-funded places, the South China Morning Post has found. Meanwhile, the intake of home-grown students taking the Diploma of Secondary Education (DSE) exam has dropped by 7 per cent, causing its proportion to fall from 82 per cent to 72 per cent, sparking calls for a cap on...
items.titleZh: 香港大学非DSE录取人数创新高，引发设立配额呼声
items.summaryZh: 香港公立大学录取非本地考试系统学生的比例在七年内激增63%，占政府资助名额的近30%。与此同时，本地DSE考生的录取比例下降，引发了社会对设立录取配额的讨论。
items.whyImportant: 这触及了香港高等教育资源分配的公平性问题。

items.titleZh: 中国被忽视的互联网大军正悄然将人工智能嵌入日常业务
items.summaryZh: 除了知名的AI实验室外，中国电商、游戏、社交媒体和旅游等领域的消费平台正在开发适合自身生态系统的基础模型。这些企业正通过将AI技术融入日常业务，实现技术落地。
items.whyImportant: 这显示了中国AI产业正从实验室走向广泛的商业应用。

items.title: Iran’s foreign minister calls threat of new US economic sanctions ‘desperate’
items.summary: Abbas Araghchi says country is unbowed but president Masoud Pezeshkian admits its people face ‘many problems’ Iran’s foreign minister has dismissed the threat of a fresh round of US economic sanctions as a “desperate” ploy, even as its president acknowledged that the Iranian people are facing “many problems” amid Washington’s efforts to isolate and debilitate the country’s economy. Last week, Donald Trump announced a new campaign to increase the pressure on the Iranian economy, calling it “the most crushing economic operation ever taken against any country”. The US Treasury secretary, Scott Bessent, is expected to announce further punitive economic measures on Iran – which he has described as “the toughest sanctions in history” – on Monday. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 伊朗外长称美国新经济制裁威胁是“绝望之举”
items.summaryZh: 伊朗外长阿巴斯·阿拉格希驳斥了美国的新制裁威胁，称其为绝望的策略。尽管总统佩泽希齐扬承认伊朗人民面临诸多困难，但政府表示不会屈服于华盛顿的经济压力。
items.whyImportant: 美伊之间的经济对抗进一步升级，加剧了地区紧张局势。

items.summary: Chinese archaeologists will carry out their first joint field project in South America by exploring sites dating back thousands of years in Peru as Beijing steps up its efforts to deepen cultural ties with the region. items.titleZh: 中国考古学家前往秘鲁开展首个联合项目，探索古代遗址
items.summaryZh: 中国社会科学院考古研究所与秘鲁相关机构签署协议，将共同探索秘鲁数千年前的古代遗址。这是中国在南美洲开展的首个联合考古项目，旨在深化双方文化联系。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着中国在拉美地区的文化外交与学术合作迈出新步伐。
